blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The local government of Infanta, Quezon has cancelled the business permits of four crushing plants and a mobile crusher following alleged violations of Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) permitting requirements. In a report posted on Facebook on Thursday, Infanta officials said the permits were cancelled after the DENR issued a cease-and- desist order following a field investigation by its Composite Monitoring Team on Sept. 9 and 10. The investigation found that Reina Readymix Construction OPC, Ultrarocks Corporation, Frepa Aggregates Trading, MCDC Hauling Services/Gravel and Sand, and Sta.
